intro: Convert US tablespoons (tbsp) to cups accurately for baking recipes, butter sticks, spice blends, and coffee brewing. Under the US Customary kitchen standard, 1 cup equals exactly 16 tablespoons, so 1 tablespoon equals 0.0625 cups (1/16 cup)—simply divide tablespoons by 16. Use the calculator above or check exact fractions and decimals from 0.5 tbsp to 64 tbsp below.
alsoWrittenAs: tbsp to cup, tbsp to cups, T to c, US tablespoons to US cups
tableTitle: Tablespoons to Cups Conversion Chart (0.5 tbsp to 64 tbsp)
tableSubtitle: Exact US kitchen equivalents computed with cup = tbsp ÷ 16 (16 tbsp = 1 US cup).
tableRoundingNote: Computed from the exact US Customary ratio 16 tbsp = 1 US cup (1 tbsp = 0.0625 cup = 14.78676 mL). All whole-tablespoon inputs produce exact 4-decimal or shorter fractions with zero rounding error.

workedExamples.title: Baking Oil & Syrup Measure (6 tbsp)
workedExamples.scenario: Convert 6 tablespoons into cups for liquid baking ingredients.
workedExamples.stepByStep: 6 tbsp ÷ 16 = 0.375 cup exact (3/8 cup, or 1/4 cup + 2 tbsp).

workedExamples.title: Scaled Sauce or Butter Measure (11 tbsp)
workedExamples.scenario: Convert 11 tablespoons into cups when halving or scaling a recipe.
workedExamples.stepByStep: 11 tbsp ÷ 16 = 0.6875 cup exact (11/16 cup, just under 3/4 cup).

workedExamples.title: Large Batch Dry or Liquid Measure (18 tbsp)
workedExamples.scenario: Convert 18 tablespoons into cups for batch cooking.
workedExamples.stepByStep: 18 tbsp ÷ 16 = 1.125 cup exact (1 1/8 cups, or 1 cup + 2 tbsp).

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: US Customary Cup (16 × 14.79 mL) vs. Australian Metric Cup (250 mL)
items: One US Customary cup equals 16 US tablespoons (236.59 mL), and US FDA nutrition labels round 1 cup to 240 mL (16 × 15 mL tbsp). Either way, the ratio remains 16 tbsp per cup.
Australian metric recipes use a 250 mL cup and a 20 mL tablespoon (only 12.5 tablespoons per cup), while standard UK/Canadian metric spoons are 15 mL (~16.67 tbsp per 250 mL metric cup).

faqs.question: How many cups are in 1 tablespoon?
faqs.answer: There are 0.0625 US cups (1/16 cup) in 1 US tablespoon. Conversely, 1 US cup equals exactly 16 tablespoons.

faqs.question: How many tablespoons in a cup of coffee?
faqs.answer: By liquid volume, 1 US cup holds 16 tablespoons (and a classic 6 fl oz coffee 'cup' marking on drip brewers equals 12 tablespoons). For coffee grounds, standard brewing guides use 1 to 2 tablespoons per 6 fl oz cup (about 2 tbsp per 8 fl oz US cup).

faqs.question: How many cups is 8 tablespoons?
faqs.answer: 8 US tablespoons equals exactly 0.5 cups (1/2 cup, or 1 standard US stick of butter).

faqs.question: What is 18 tablespoons in cups?
faqs.answer: 18 US tablespoons equals exactly 1.125 cups (1 and 1/8 cups, or 1 cup plus 2 tablespoons).
